'''Massimo Tagge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the influential [[House of Tagge/Legends|Tagge family]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Chief Instructor]] at the Empire's [[Carida Academy/Legends|Military Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. During his tenure, he discovered the gifted [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] [[Natasi Daala]] and transferred her to his own [[Officer/Legends|officer]]-cadet program, from that of Instructor [[Visk (individual)|Visk]]. Daala produced a number of tactical analysis papers on the subject of the [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Tarkin Doctrine]], a methodology for maintaining order that was developed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and Tagge forwarded copies of the documents to his cousin, [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]].
